SAROVA LION HILL GAME LODGE
Luxury Lodge in Lake Nakuru National Park | Safari in Kenya | Africa Safari | Eco-Certified
Experience the wonder of Lake Nakuru National Park, one of Kenya's most iconic safari destinations. Home to the endangered white rhino, a dazzling population of pink flamingos, and Kenya's third-largest lake, this park promises unforgettable moments for nature and wildlife enthusiasts.
Nestled on "The Lion Hill," Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge offers a perfect blend of adventure, luxury, and relaxation. Each classic chalet-style room features a private terrace with stunning views of the park and Lake Nakuru. Whether you're savouring world-class cuisine, taking a refreshing dip in the pool, or indulging in an outdoor spa treatment, this lodge connects you with nature in unparalleled ways.
Recognized in the 2023 World Luxury Hotel Awards as a top Luxury Safari Lodge, Luxury Game Lodge, and Luxury Family Hotel in Africa, Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge stands as a premier choice for families, couples, and nature lovers. Its Silver Eco-Rating from Eco Tourism Kenya highlights its dedication to sustainable tourism and eco-friendly practices.
For those seeking lodges in Lake Nakuru National Park or a safari in Kenya, Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge is your ultimate destination for exceptional experiences, relaxation and cherished memories.
Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge has been appointed as a winner in 3 outstanding categories in the 2023 World Luxury Hotel Awards . Voted Luxury Safari Lodge & Luxury Game Lodge in East Africa as well as Luxury Family Hotel, Africa, these wins are a testament to the unwavering trust and support from our incredible guests that inspires us to provide exceptional hospitality, every day.
Eco Tourism Kenya has given Sarova Lion Hill a silver eco-rating, recognizing the game lodge for demonstrating innovation towards achieving excellence in environmental conservation, responsible resource use and socio-economic investment.
Come and experience a breathtaking safari in Kenya that will remain etched in your memory forever!

A SAFARI EXPERIENCE
At Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge, immerse yourself in the ultimate safari adventure and relaxation. Start your day with a refreshing swim in the pool, enjoy a jog along our scenic dedicated track, or gather friends for a fun board game session. In the evenings, experience the rich culture of the region with our vibrant cultural nights that celebrate local traditions.
Explore the wonders of Lake Nakuru National Park on game drives that promise thrilling wildlife encounters. Witness the iconic flocks of pink flamingos, a variety of bird species, and the park’s renowned rhinos—both the white and endangered black rhinos. Keep your eyes peeled for the rare tree-climbing lions and elusive leopards, as well as buffalo, zebra, and giraffes that roam the savannah.
For those searching for lodges in Lake Nakuru National Park or seeking an extraordinary safari in Kenya, Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge offers the perfect balance of adventure, relaxation, and awe-inspiring nature. Your next incredible escape awaits!

Zawadi FAQs
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
1. What is Sarova Zawadi Loyalty Program?
Sarova Zawadi Loyalty Program is a points based 3 tier program that rewards you the member for being a valued and frequent guest of the Sarova Hotels. The Sarova Zawadi Loyalty program allows you to earn points at any of our properties, these points can be redeemed for exciting choices of reward options.
2. How do I join Sarova Zawadi Program?
Joining is easy and free to become a part of this amazing program. Simply visit our Sarova Zawadi Loyalty program Website: https://bookings.sarovahotels.com/en/myaccount/registration and click on "Join us." Enter your personal information and you immediately become a member and are now on your way to enjoying a world of rewards from free nights to complimentary spa treatments and many more at any of our Sarova Hotels.
3. Why should I join Sarova Zawadi Loyalty Program?
Sarova Zawadi program offers members enticing benefits which include:
1) Redeeming points for free nights,
2) Room upgrades
3) Spa treatments
4) 48 Hour Guaranteed Room availability,
5) High Speed Internet in the room
6) Late Check-out
Visit our Sarova Zawadi page https://bookings.sarovahotels.com/en/myaccount/login for many more
4. How do I earn Sarova Zawadi Loyalty points?
Members can earn Sarova Zawadi Loyalty points easily by staying at any of the Sarova Hotels participating properties. All you need is to sign up for free and points are automatically awarded to your account after your eligible stay or spend in the Restaurants, Bar, on Laundry and Spa services and Health Club membership.
5. What is an eligible stay?
- An eligible stay is a room booked directly through Sarova Hotels Reservations or Sarova Zawadi office by the member.
- Accommodation booked through Travel agents bookings, Contracted or negotiated rates will not be eligible for points.
- In situations where a special offer is running a Member will still earn points on accommodation.
- Members booked for conferences/events or groups will NOT earn points on their stay.
- Members booked through conferences/events/banquets or Groups and Tours and paid for by third party will not earn points.
Please refer to our Terms and Conditions on the website https://bookings.sarovahotels.com/en/myaccount/login for more details.
6. How many points do members earn per stay?
A member will earn 1 point for every 100 Kenya shillings spend excluding taxes.
7. Can I earn points on other parts of my hotel bill, like restaurant, spa, or Laundry?
Yes, a member will earn points on specified services Accommodation, Restaurant, Bar, Spa and Laundry.
8. What can I not earn points on?
A member cannot earn points on conferences, or outside catering, contracted or negotiated rates, or any third-party booking.
9. Can I earn points if I book a room for someone else?
Yes! A member can earn points for up to 5 rooms on direct bookings as long as one room is occupied by the member and paying for all the rooms.
Redemption of points will only be awarded to a Zawadi member enrolled. Ensure that the email address is attached to the reservation.
10. What can I get for my points?
Members can redeem with their Zawadi Loyalty points free nights at any of our Sarova Hotels. We will be constantly adding new things to our redemption rewards menu.
11. How many points do I need to redeem for a free night?
Just as with varying room rates for each hotel, redemption points will also vary by hotel. Redemption points may increase depending on yearly rates structure or times of demand. It may take more points to redeem during a busy or peak season. More details on the rewards will be on the website on https://bookings.sarovahotels.com/en/myaccount/login =
12. How do I redeem my points for awards?
A member can easily redeem his/her points by logging into his/her profile at https://bookings.sarovahotels.com/en/myaccount/login and either request a stay or choose the item he/she would like to redeem. Or contact Zawadi Loyalty office during normal business hours (8:00 am – 5:00 pm) and our team will be happy to assist! For room reservations, guests must redeem at least 48 hours prior to the desire check-in date.
13. Can I redeem my Zawadi Loyalty points for cash?
Zawadi Loyalty points has no cash value. The points can be redeemed for free nights.
14. What if I have points but not enough for a free night? Can I use my points and pay the rest in cash?
Your Zawadi Loyalty account must have enough points to cover the entire requested redemption stay or night. Members cannot use partial points and part cash for a redemption stay.
15. Am I only allowed to redeem for a limited number of free nights?
No. If you have sufficient points to cover each night, you can book as many free nights as you would like.
16. Can my spouse or family use my Zawadi card to earn or redeem points in my absence?
No. For security and personal data privacy the registered member whose names appear on the card is the only one who can earn and redeem the points. Kindly note for the case of redeeming of points the member can purchase a gift voucher worth the night stay to gift to another person.
17. Are points or benefits transferrable?
No. Points are not transferrable, similarly benefits aligned on member card are exclusive for the member whose names appear on the card.
18. What if I need to cancel or make changes to a reservation booked with Zawadi Loyalty points?
Members can easily contact Zawadi Customer services office to make changes or cancellations for any Reservations made. Changes or cancellations to Zawadi redemptions MUST be made five days prior to scheduled arrival or a one night worth points will be forfeited. Email us at Sarovazawadi@sarovahotels.com or telephone number +254 0202767233 and we will be happy to assist.

SAROVA SHABA GAME LODGE
Kenya's Leading Safari Lodge in Shaba National Park / Luxury Safari Lodge in Kenya
Nestled within the tranquil oasis of Shaba National Reserve, Sarova Shaba Game Lodge offers an unparalleled luxury safari experience. It serves as as your gateway to Kenya's wild beauty, with breathtaking landscapes and rich wildlife creating the perfect backdrop for an unforgettable adventure. Known as the land of "Born Free," made famous by Joy and George Adamson’s tale of Elsa the lioness, Shaba blends history, conservation, and magic into one extraordinary destination.
Stay in one of our 85 elegantly spacious rooms, each offering stunning views of the Ewaso Nyiro River or our lush gardens nourished by natural streams. Whether you’re relaxing by the pool, indulging in fish foot therapy, dining under the starlit African sky, or embarking on a guided safari, every moment is crafted to leave you rejuvenated and inspired.
Ready to embark on the safari adventure of a lifetime? Sarova Shaba Game Lodge awaits.
Book online or call our reservations desk on +254709111000 to assist you with your room reservation.
Enhancing Your Experience
We are currently refining our spaces through a refurbishment exercise that is being carried out in phases. The lodge remains open, and all works are being carried out with minimum guest interruption .
We look forward to welcoming you to an even more memorable experience soon.
View Rates

Safari Experience
Shaba National Reserve holds a significant place in Kenya’s conservation history. It was once the home of legendary conservationists Joy and George Adamson. Joy's iconic books, Born Free and Living Free, immortalized the story of Elsa the lioness and Shaba's wild charm.
The lodge itself has welcomed notable guests, including Sir Richard Harris, who stayed here for weeks while filming To Walk with Lions, a movie based on the Adamsons’ story. Whether you're captivated by wildlife, intrigued by conservation history, or looking to immerse yourself in Kenya's untamed wilderness, Shaba offers an experience like no other.
Sarova Shaba Game Lodge: where history and nature meet for an unforgettable safari.

Our Luxurious Rooms
Indulge in the ultimate comfort and serenity at Sarova Shaba Game Lodge. Each of our 85 chalet-style rooms combines vintage charm with cozy, inviting décor, offering a restful retreat in the heart of Kenya's wilderness. Step out onto your private veranda to soak in breathtaking views of the Ewaso Nyiro River and the untouched beauty of Shaba National Reserve. Let the gentle sounds of the flowing river and the tranquil surroundings create a rejuvenating escape, perfect for relaxation after a day of adventure.
Find out more
Â
Our Restaurant
Dining at Sarova Shaba Game Lodge is a unique safari experience in itself. At Surpelei Restaurant , our elevated dining space, you can enjoy exquisite meals while taking in sweeping views of the wilderness. Watch as hippos and crocodiles lounge along the Ewaso Nyiro River, creating a dining atmosphere like no other.
Our menu features exceptional cuisine crafted from fresh, sustainably sourced ingredients, including produce from local farmers and our own organic garden. Whether you're enjoying an à la carte selection or a themed buffet, every bite is a celebration of flavour and culture. With attentive service and a touch of Kenyan tradition, your dining experience will be truly unforgettable.
Find out more
Â
Our Bars
Imagine savoring your favorite tipple, while listening to the stories and songs of the Samburu people. Imagine doing so under the stars at our Chemi Chemi Bar, built interconnectedly with the lush vegetation and natural water streams or at a river gorge watching sunsets. We invite you to connect with nature and culture, and to create memories that will last a lifetime.
Find out more
Â
MEETINGS & CONFERENCING
Elevate your team’s creativity and collaboration with a meeting or conference at Sarova Shaba Game Lodge, nestled in the heart of the African bush. Our indoor conference facility accommodates up to 40 participants, providing an intimate yet professional environment equipped with all the essentials. Looking for something unique? Opt for an outdoor setup surrounded by the stunning wilderness, where fresh air and inspiring landscapes set the tone for productivity and innovation. Whether it's brainstorming, strategizing, or team-building, Sarova Shaba offers the ideal setting to achieve remarkable results.
Find out more
Â
Weddings and Events
Host your dream wedding or special event at Sarova Shaba Game Lodge, where breathtaking savannah landscapes provide a one-of-a-kind backdrop. From intimate ceremonies to grand celebrations, our team is dedicated to bringing your vision to life with a fresh and innovative approach. Each detail is carefully tailored to reflect your unique style and preferences, ensuring an unforgettable experience for you and your guests.
Whether you're exchanging vows or celebrating milestones, Sarova Shaba is the perfect destination for moments that will be cherished forever.
Find out more

jsonLd.description: Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge is nestled along the Lion Hill overlooking the spectacular flamingo pink rimmed Lake Nakuru. Its location affords panoramic views of the Lake Nakuru National Park. A short two-hour drive from Nairobi, Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge is a favourite with residents and visitors to Kenya.

jsonLd.name: Sarova Shaba Game Lodge | Kenya
jsonLd.description: Sarova Shaba Game Lodge in Kenya is your perfect destination for a safari in Africa. It is located in a natural oasis in the heart of the Shaba National Reserve just east of Samburu, Kenya. Nestled along the banks of the Ewaso Nyiro River, natural spring waters stream throughout the Lodge and flow into the river. A haven of nature with winding walkways, indigenous trees and towering Doum Palms.
